entries.label: Enemy spawner
entries.searchable: enemySpawner Enemy spawner Invisible during play. While its authored area is on screen, it rolls once per second and teleports in one already-alert enemy on a successful roll.

entries.label: Editor's mailbox
entries.searchable: mailbox Editor's mailbox An editor-letter mailbox. Each placed mailbox owns its own trigger distance, letter, thought, and timing metadata, so a level can contain several tutorial letters.

entries.label: Location thought trigger
entries.searchable: thoughtTrigger Location thought trigger Invisible one-shot region that pauses play and shows an Ignatius thought bubble when entered.

entries.label: Question mark trigger
entries.searchable: questionMarkTrigger Question mark trigger Invisible one-shot trigger that shows a question mark above Ignatius for two seconds.

entries.label: Exclamation mark trigger
entries.searchable: exclamationMarkTrigger Exclamation mark trigger Invisible one-shot trigger that shows an exclamation mark above Ignatius for two seconds.

entries.label: Wizard entry door
entries.searchable: wizard_entry_door Wizard entry door The effective level start. It snaps to nearby ground, opens, lets Ignatius walk out behind the foreground door layer, then closes.

entries.label: Wizard entry point
entries.searchable: wizard_entry_point Wizard entry point Invisible immediate level start. Ignatius begins at this floor-anchored point with no doorway animation.

entries.label: Wizard exit door
entries.searchable: wizard_exit_door Wizard exit door The level exit. It is mirrored by default, snaps to nearby ground, opens when Ignatius approaches, and walks him through before loading its destination level.

entries.label: Wizard exit point
entries.searchable: wizard_exit_point Wizard exit point Invisible immediate level exit. Reaching this point loads its destination without a doorway animation.

entries.label: Treasure chest
entries.searchable: treasureChest Treasure chest Automatic proximity treasure chest: begins open with loot, awards Score once, then remains open and empty.

entries.label: Breakable crate
entries.searchable: breakableCrate Breakable crate A solid reactive crate that intercepts rockets, becomes damaged, then disappears when destroyed.

entries.label: Breakable iron barrier
entries.searchable: destructibleBarrier Breakable iron barrier A tall solid barrier that intercepts rockets, bends when damaged, and removes its collision when destroyed.

entries.label: Lever switch
entries.searchable: leverSwitch Lever switch Nearby switch that toggles a named signal channel. Press Down, S, or Enter to operate it.

entries.label: Keyhole switch
entries.searchable: keyholeSwitch Keyhole switch Consumes the configured key when Ignatius operates it, then emits its named signal once.

entries.label: Spiked gate
